name: 92656 · Aliso Viejo, CA
findings: ZIP 92656 (Aliso Viejo) has 169 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92656 (Aliso Viejo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
